components.name: Translate Button
components.description: Submits the typed phrase for translation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 33px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent); font: 700 10px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, transform .16s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Multiline source text entry with a visible focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-message">Votre message</label><textarea class="ds-textarea" id="ds-message" rows="3" placeholder="Écrivez votre texte…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; color: var(--muted); font: 700 9px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 62px; padding: 13px 14px 9px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); font: 400 13px/1.55 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Language Selector
components.description: One side of the source and target language pair.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 7px 3px; color: var(--muted); font: 700 9px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-select { height: 47px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-select select { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; color: var(--text); background: transparent; font: 600 12px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Translator Surface
components.description: The central work area holding language selection, microphone, and text entry.
components.html:
Parlez ou écrivez

Votre traduction apparaîtra ici.
components.css: .ds-translator { padding: 22px 26px 23px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 19px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 18px 54px rgba(27, 55, 39, .075), 0 2px 8px rgba(27, 55, 39, .035); font: 400 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-translator h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-translator p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Microphone Control
components.description: Primary voice control with idle, listening, and processing states.
components.html: <button class="ds-microphone" type="button" aria-label="Démarrer la reconnaissance vocale"><svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="11" y="4" width="10" height="17" rx="5"/><path d="M7 15v1a9 9 0 0 0 18 0v-1M16 25v4m-5 0h10"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-microphone { width: 77px; height: 77px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .18s, background .18s; } .ds-microphone:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-microphone svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: History Tabs
components.description: Switches the side panel between recent translations and saved favorites.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-soft); } .ds-tab { min-height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; font: 600 11px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab.is-active { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.07); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Talk Translate is a calm wayfinding surface for a conversation between two people who do not share a language. The interface makes the pair of languages, the current speaker, and the translated response easy to locate without turning a short exchange into a sequence of setup screens.

The visual language is restrained and light: generous neutral space, a leaf-green action color, soft surfaces, and compact labels that help travelers scan controls quickly. The same system inverts its neutral tones for dark mode. Inter is the explicitly requested interface face; its size and weight changes, rather than a second family, establish hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: One green accent; neutral tones carry the rest of the interface.
A centered, narrow work surface, designed to remain usable on a phone.
Speaker and language changes are expressed as clear states, not decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use green for the primary action and active state. Do not introduce additional decorative accent colors; reserve red for errors and other distinct colors for explicit status only.

rules.name: The Scan-First Rule
rules.body: Keep labels short and high-contrast; use size and weight, not a second font, to distinguish the task from its controls.

dos: Do keep the language pair, microphone, and text entry in that task order.
Do preserve visible focus, live status announcements, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the same accent for selected and primary-action states in both themes.
donts: Don't add decorative colors, gradients, or external interface libraries.
Don't obscure the translated phrase with controls or supporting metadata.
Don't imply that source-language detection is known when the provider does not return it.
